text:
Ethan Park: Heads-up  final onsite candidate Luca P. is arriving late-night from abroad (flight lands 23:40). They asked for a visa invitation letter + late check-in instructions. Need hotel + after-hours escort plan.
Marta Ruiz: flight land time ok. Are they traveling on a tourist/business visa or visa waiver? We need to confirm so we provide the correct paperwork.
Recruiter Bot: Candidate said theyre on a business visa application and requested an invitation letter for the consulate showing interview dates and office address. They also asked if Redwood can cover a SIM card for data.
Immigration: We can generate an invitation letter template. Need: full legal name, passport number, nationality, intended interview date range, and purpose. Please collect passport copy via secure upload link, not Slack.
Ethan Park: I'll DM Luca the secure upload link. Luca said passport ends in 4 digits 7421 and nationality = Spain. Interview date is 2026-04-02. Purpose: "Final interview loop - Software Engineer".
Travel Vendor: For after-hours arrival we recommend booking the hotel with 24h front desk or do a guaranteed late check-in. Corporate hotels we can use: GlobalStay (24h), rate $210/night. Approve?
Marta Ruiz: approve GlobalStay. Please guarantee late arrival and request a ground-floor room (mobility preference noted).
Front Desk: After-hours arrival protocol: enter via Delivery Gate A after 8pm; bring photo ID. Call desk at +1-555-888-0044 on arrival and we will escort from loading bay to main lobby. Note: we need name on the badge request matching passport name.
Ethan Park: will request badge with passport name. Also Luca requested a local SIM (number + data) because their roaming is expensive. Travel Vendor, can you arrange a prepaid SIM to be ready at check-in?
Travel Vendor: Yes. Prepaid SIM can be added to the hotel folio or given as a small cash-paid item. Corporate policy allows purchase up to $50. Approve?
Marta Ruiz: approve up to $50 for SIM. Add to folio if vendor supports it; otherwise we'll reimburse.
People Ops Bot: Expense template reminder: ["Expense Type: Candidate Support", "Amount: $XX", "Candidate: Luca P.", "Approver: Marta Ruiz"]. If vendor paid, create vendor-payment ticket.
Immigration: I'll draft the invitation letter now. Ethan, please confirm exact passport name string (match passport) and email address for sending the official PDF. Also note: consulates sometimes ask for an itinerary & hotel confirmation  include both in the package.
Ethan Park: confirmed passport name = "Luca1 Pe9rez" (will upload passport scan). Email on file: luca.perez@example.es. I'll attach travel itinerary + hotel booking when Travel Vendor confirms.
Front Desk: After-hours badge note: we can pre-print a visitor badge and leave it at Loading Bay A for courier handoff but need escort name for access. Who will meet them?
Marta Ruiz: I can meet at 23:20 in Loading Bay A. Adding a 23:15 meet to calendar.
Ethan Park: thanks. I'll let Luca know the meetup and front desk number. Also adding phone: +1-555-888-0044 and instruction: "text 'Luca P - arrived'" to expedite.
Travel Vendor: hotel booking confirmed: GlobalStay reservation #G-99321, guaranteed late check-in, folio link added to calendar. Prepaid SIM will be ready at front desk; vendor will charge hotel folio $45.
Immigration: invitation letter drafted and saved to secure folder. Ethan please confirm when passport scan uploaded and I'll attach the passport number in the letter.
Ethan Park: passport scan uploaded to secure link. Immigration: please attach letter + calendar invite and send to Luca with consulate notes.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: do not post passport scans on Slack. Use secure upload only. Policy ref: HR-Security-007.
Marta Ruiz: catering note  candidate requested a late dinner; kitchen can prepare a boxed meal (no pork). Luca preference: pescatarian. Front Desk, please confirm if kitchen can hold the box for late pickup at GlobalStay front desk.
Front Desk: We'll coordinate with kitchen. The boxed meal will be delivered to GlobalStay front desk at 11:05pm labeled "Luca P - Redwood". We'll escort candidate with the meal to the interview desk area.
People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Luca Pe9rez. Badge ETA: 20m after arrival. After-hours door access code will expire at 2:00am.
Ethan Park: Reimbursement instructions for taxi/SIM if candidate pays: forward receipts to expenses@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Support - Luca Perez - [date]". Reimburse within 3 business days.
Travel Vendor: Note: airport pick-up can be added if flight delay >60m. We can convert folio to include a car and send driver details to Ethan.
Marta Ruiz: good. If flight delayed beyond 1 hour, we'll pre-book a car and notify candidate.
Ethan Park: closing loop  I'll DM Luca the secure upload link, meet spot details, and Front Desk number. Ping here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
People Ops Bot: This thread will be archived after 7 days per channel retention policy.
